message.reasoning_content: We need to determine appropriate crimes. Facts:傅某委托庄某再物色便宜盗赃三轮摩托车，购买后自用。 So he knowingly bought stolen property. That is "掩饰、隐瞒犯罪所得、犯罪所得收益" (concealing/receiving stolen property). Also possibly theft? He didn't steal himself, but he purchased stolen goods. The crime is receiving stolen property. In examples, they label as "掩饰、隐瞒犯罪所得、犯罪所得收益". Also sometimes include theft if he also stole? He didn't commit theft. So only that. Also maybe "非法经营" no. So answer: [罪名]掩饰、隐瞒犯罪所得、犯罪所得收益<eoa>
